stories.title: Rodgers throws two TDs to tie Peyton on all-time list, lifts Steelers to OT win
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers tied Peyton Manning on the all-time passing touchdown list with 539 in the Steelers' overtime victory.

stories.title: Sources: Kings guard Simmons believed to have torn Achilles tendon
stories.summary: Sacramento Kings guard Ben Simmons, a three-time All-Star who agreed to a one-year, $3.5 million contract on Sept. 4, is believed to have sustained a torn Achilles tendon after receiving a preliminary diagnosis on the injury, sources told ESPN on Sunday.

stories.title: Warriors' Curry limps out of practice after tweaking knee
stories.summary: Stephen Curry left the Warriors' open practice in San Francisco on Sunday night after appearing to tweak his right knee on a perimeter move.

stories.title: Bills CB Gardner-Johnson ejected after apparent spitting incident
stories.summary: With his team leading 13-10 at the time, Buffalo Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson was ejected from Sunday's game against Las Vegas following an altercation in the final minute of the first half, when he appeared to spit in the Raiders' direction.

stories.title: Giants' QB and RB situations left unsettled after home loss to Saints
stories.summary: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Sunday he's not ready to name a starting quarterback for Week 7 after J.J. McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston against the Saints.
